local MAX_ZOOM = 3
local MIN_ZOOM = 1
local ZOOM_TOGGLE_FACTOR = 1.5

---@param offset number
---@return nil
local function zoom(offset)
    local current = hl.get_config("cursor.zoom_factor")
    if offset ~= nil then
        current = current + offset
    elseif current ~= MIN_ZOOM then
        current = MIN_ZOOM
    else
        current = ZOOM_TOGGLE_FACTOR
    end
    current = math.max(MIN_ZOOM, math.min(MAX_ZOOM, current))
    hl.config({ cursor = { zoom_factor = current } })
end

hl.bind("SUPER + Z", zoom)
hl.bind("SUPER + KP_ADD", function()
    zoom(0.5)
end)
hl.bind("SUPER + minus", function()
    zoom(-0.5)
end)

# Capture screen, save to file, and copy to clipboard

#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

DIR="$HOME/Pictures/Screenshots"
mkdir -p "$DIR"

TIME=$(date +"%d-%m-%Y_%H-%M-%S")
FILE="$DIR/Screenshot_${TIME}.png"

# Capture screen, save to file, and copy to clipboard
if grim - | tee "$FILE" | wl-copy; then
    notify-send "📸 Screenshot Captured" "Saved to $(basename "$FILE")\nCopied to clipboard!"
else
    notify-send "❌ Screenshot Failed" "Could not capture screen."
    exit 1
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash

DIR="$HOME/Pictures/Screenshots"
set -euo pipefail

    sleep 0.2
done

    sleep 2
fi

if [ -n "$DEVICE_NAME" ]; then
    DEVICE_ID=$(kdeconnect-cli -a | grep "$DEVICE_NAME" | cut -d':' -f1)

if [ -n "$DEVICE_ID" ]; then

        notify-send "Sent to your phone" "$(basename "$FILE")"
    else
        notify-send "Send failed" "Saved locally"
    fi
else
    notify-send "No device found" "Saved locally"
fi

# Uses wf-recorder targeting the focused Hyprland output with audio enabled
# Sending SIGINT (Ctrl+C equivalent) allows wf-recorder to gracefully write the MP4 container

#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

RECORD_DIR="$HOME/Pictures/Recordings"
TEMP_FILE="/tmp/wfr_last_file"
PID_FILE="/tmp/wfr.pid"

mkdir -p "$RECORD_DIR"

start_recording() {
    MONITOR=$(hyprctl monitors -j | jq -r '.[] | select(.focused == true) | .name')

    if [[ -z "$MONITOR" || "$MONITOR" == "null" ]]; then
        notify-send "❌ Recording failed" "Couldn't determine focused monitor."
        exit 1
    fi

    FILENAME="Screen_recording_$(date +"%d%m%Y_%H%M%S").mp4"
    OUTPUT="$RECORD_DIR/$FILENAME"

    notify-send "🔴 Recording Started" "Monitor: $MONITOR"

    # Uses wf-recorder targeting the focused Hyprland output with audio enabled
    wf-recorder \
        --audio \
        -o "$MONITOR" \
        -f "$OUTPUT" >/dev/null 2>&1 &

    PID=$!

    sleep 1

    if ! kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
        notify-send "❌ Recording failed" "wf-recorder exited immediately."
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "$PID" > "$PID_FILE"
    echo "$FILENAME" > "$TEMP_FILE"
}

stop_recording() {
    if [[ ! -f "$PID_FILE" ]]; then
        notify-send "Recording" "No active recording."
        exit 0
    fi

    PID=$(cat "$PID_FILE")

    if kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
        # Sending SIGINT (Ctrl+C equivalent) allows wf-recorder to gracefully write the MP4 container
        kill -INT "$PID"

        while kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; do
            sleep 0.2
        done
    fi

    rm -f "$PID_FILE"

    FILENAME=$(cat "$TEMP_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
    rm -f "$TEMP_FILE"

    FILE="$RECORD_DIR/$FILENAME"

    if [[ -n "$FILENAME" && -f "$FILE" ]]; then
        notify-send "✅ Recording Saved" "$FILENAME\nLocation: $RECORD_DIR"
    else
        notify-send "⚠️ Recording Stopped" "Output file not found."
    fi
}

if [[ -f "$PID_FILE" ]]; then
    stop_recording
else
    start_recording
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

RECORD_DIR="$HOME/Pictures/Recordings"
TEMP_FILE="/tmp/gsr_last_file"
PID_FILE="/tmp/gsr.pid"

mkdir -p "$RECORD_DIR"

start_recording() {
    MONITOR=$(hyprctl monitors -j | jq -r '.[] | select(.focused == true) | .name')

    if [[ -z "$MONITOR" || "$MONITOR" == "null" ]]; then
        notify-send "❌ Recording failed" "Couldn't determine focused monitor."
        exit 1
    fi

    FILENAME="Screen_recording_$(date +"%d%m%Y_%H%M%S").mp4"
    OUTPUT="$RECORD_DIR/$FILENAME"

    notify-send "🔴 Recording Started" "Monitor: $MONITOR"

    # Uses NVENC via Wayland screencopy
    wl-screenrec \
        --output "$MONITOR" \
        --audio \
        --encode-gop 60 \
        --filename "$OUTPUT" >/dev/null 2>&1 &

    PID=$!

    sleep 1

    if ! kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
        notify-send "❌ Recording failed" "wl-screenrec exited immediately."
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "$PID" > "$PID_FILE"
    echo "$FILENAME" > "$TEMP_FILE"
}

stop_recording() {
    if [[ ! -f "$PID_FILE" ]]; then
        notify-send "Recording" "No active recording."
        exit 0
    fi

    PID=$(cat "$PID_FILE")

    if kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
        kill -INT "$PID"

        while kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; do
            sleep 0.2
        done
    fi

    rm -f "$PID_FILE"

    FILENAME=$(cat "$TEMP_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
    rm -f "$TEMP_FILE"

    FILE="$RECORD_DIR/$FILENAME"

    if [[ -n "$FILENAME" && -f "$FILE" ]]; then
        notify-send "✅ Recording Saved" "$FILENAME\nLocation: $RECORD_DIR"
    else
        notify-send "⚠️ Recording Stopped" "Output file not found."
    fi
}

if [[ -f "$PID_FILE" ]]; then
    stop_recording
else
    start_recording
fi
